info.title: Recall API
info.description: API documentation for the Recall application

post.summary: Registers an OAuth client as an agent of a tenant, with its first grant.

parameters.name: X-Recall-User
parameters.description: The `sub` of `GET /auth/me` when the page opened. A request with the session cookie must send it, and any other value gets a 409 problem with the type `urn:recall:problem:page-user-mismatch`. A request with a bearer token does not send it.

401.description: The request has no valid access token.

507.description: The disk of the server is full, so nothing changed.

get.summary: Gets a paginated list of Agents.

X-Pagination.description: The pagination data for the returned page, as JSON.

401.description: The request has no valid access token.

post.summary: Adds a permission to the grant of an Agent. The caller must hold the permission.

507.description: The disk of the server is full, so nothing changed.

delete.summary: Deletes an Agent. Its client can no longer act in the tenant from the next request.

507.description: The disk of the server is full, so nothing changed.

get.summary: Gets a single Agent by ID.

401.description: The request has no valid access token.

delete.summary: Removes a permission from the grant of an Agent. The caller needs the manage_agents permission.

parameters.description: The `sub` of `GET /auth/me` when the page opened. A request with the session cookie must send it, and any other value gets a 409 problem with the type `urn:recall:problem:page-user-mismatch`. A request with a bearer token does not send it.

401.description: The request has no valid access token.

507.description: The disk of the server is full, so nothing changed.

get.summary:
Gets one page of audit entries, newest first. With an entityId, it gets the history of that aggregate root and
its children. With no entityId, it gets the entries of the tenant. Needs read_audit_log. A value that the caller
may not read has hidden set and no old or new value. To get the next page, send the nextCursor of this page as
the cursor. The last page has no nextCursor.

401.description: The request has no valid access token.

post.summary:
Adds a Correction of the caller, or returns the Correction that already has the ID that the body names. The
first create gives 201 and a replay gives 200, so a device can send it again after a lost response. A replay of
a deleted Correction gives 409.

parameters.name: X-Recall-User
parameters.description: The `sub` of `GET /auth/me` when the page opened. A request with the session cookie must send it, and any other value gets a 409 problem with the type `urn:recall:problem:page-user-mismatch`. A request with a bearer token does not send it.

401.description: The request has no valid access token.

507.description: The disk of the server is full, so nothing changed.

get.summary: Gets a paginated list of the Corrections of the caller, by term.

X-Pagination.description: The pagination data for the returned page, as JSON.

401.description: The request has no valid access token.

delete.summary: Deletes a Correction of the caller. Send `ifVersion`, the version that the caller saw, so that a Correction that changed after it stays and the reply is 409. With no `ifVersion`, the delete goes at any version.

parameters.name: X-Recall-User
parameters.description: The `sub` of `GET /auth/me` when the page opened. A request with the session cookie must send it, and any other value gets a 409 problem with the type `urn:recall:problem:page-user-mismatch`. A request with a bearer token does not send it.

get.summary: Gets a Correction of the caller.

put.summary: Updates a Correction of the caller.

parameters.description: The `sub` of `GET /auth/me` when the page opened. A request with the session cookie must send it, and any other value gets a 409 problem with the type `urn:recall:problem:page-user-mismatch`. A request with a bearer token does not send it.

401.description: The request has no valid access token.

507.description: The disk of the server is full, so nothing changed.

get.summary: Gets each import batch of the caller, newest first. An accepted batch stays, with the counts of its accept.

401.description: The request has no valid access token.

post.summary:
Opens an import batch: a draft area outside the journal, where an agent puts the entries of another app. No entry is
in the journal until the person accepts the batch.

parameters.name: X-Recall-User
parameters.description: The `sub` of `GET /auth/me` when the page opened. A request with the session cookie must send it, and any other value gets a 409 problem with the type `urn:recall:problem:page-user-mismatch`. A request with a bearer token does not send it.

401.description: The request has no valid access token.

507.description: The disk of the server is full, so nothing changed.

get.summary:
Gets the entries of a batch in order of their date and position, with the review of the person, the start that the
accept gives each one now, and the version of the batch. `from` and `to` limit the dates, both included.

401.description: The request has no valid access token.

put.summary:
Adds or changes entries of an open batch by Client session ID. Each entry gets an outcome, in the order of the call. The
same call again changes nothing. A put never changes what the person reviewed, and it removes no entry.

parameters.name: X-Recall-User
parameters.description: The `sub` of `GET /auth/me` when the page opened. A request with the session cookie must send it, and any other value gets a 409 problem with the type `urn:recall:problem:page-user-mismatch`. A request with a bearer token does not send it.

401.description: The request has no valid access token.

507.description: The disk of the server is full, so nothing changed.

post.summary:
Removes the named entries of an open batch. An entry that the person rejected stays, with its reject, so that a
later put cannot bring it back as kept.

parameters.name: X-Recall-User
parameters.description: The `sub` of `GET /auth/me` when the page opened. A request with the session cookie must send it, and any other value gets a 409 problem with the type `urn:recall:problem:page-user-mismatch`. A request with a bearer token does not send it.

401.description: The request has no valid access token.

507.description: The disk of the server is full, so nothing changed.

put.summary:
Rejects or keeps a day of a batch. A rejected day holds each entry of its date, also an entry that a later put adds.
An entry that the person rejected alone stays rejected when its day is kept again.

parameters.name: X-Recall-User
parameters.description: The `sub` of `GET /auth/me` when the page opened. A request with the session cookie must send it, and any other value gets a 409 problem with the type `urn:recall:problem:page-user-mismatch`. A request with a bearer token does not send it.

401.description: The request has no valid access token.

507.description: The disk of the server is full, so nothing changed.

put.summary:
Sets the whole review of one entry: rejected, the edited words or null, and the edited time or null. The last review
wins. A put of the agent never changes it.

parameters.name: X-Recall-User
parameters.description: The `sub` of `GET /auth/me` when the page opened. A request with the session cookie must send it, and any other value gets a 409 problem with the type `urn:recall:problem:page-user-mismatch`. A request with a bearer token does not send it.

401.description: The request has no valid access token.

507.description: The disk of the server is full, so nothing changed.

post.summary:
Adds an OIDC provider to the login page of the install, with no restart. The client secret goes under the key ring, and no
answer holds it. Only a person signed in to Recall can add one.

parameters.name: X-Recall-User
parameters.description: The `sub` of `GET /auth/me` when the page opened. A request with the session cookie must send it, and any other value gets a 409 problem with the type `urn:recall:problem:page-user-mismatch`. A request with a bearer token does not send it.

401.description: The request has no valid access token.

507.description: The disk of the server is full, so nothing changed.

get.summary:
Lists the login providers of the install: the ones from the app, and the ones from `Auth:Providers`, which the app cannot
change. It gives the callback URL to register at a provider. Only a person signed in to Recall can read it.

401.description: The request has no valid access token.

delete.summary:
Removes a login provider of the app and its secret. It is refused when a tenant would keep no Admin who can sign in and manage
access. Only a person signed in to Recall can remove one.

parameters.name: X-Recall-User
parameters.description: The `sub` of `GET /auth/me` when the page opened. A request with the session cookie must send it, and any other value gets a 409 problem with the type `urn:recall:problem:page-user-mismatch`. A request with a bearer token does not send it.

401.description: The request has no valid access token.

507.description: The disk of the server is full, so nothing changed.

put.summary:
Changes a login provider of the app. A blank secret keeps the stored one, and the issuer cannot change. Only a person signed
in to Recall can change one.

parameters.name: X-Recall-User
parameters.description: The `sub` of `GET /auth/me` when the page opened. A request with the session cookie must send it, and any other value gets a 409 problem with the type `urn:recall:problem:page-user-mismatch`. A request with a bearer token does not send it.

401.description: The request has no valid access token.

507.description: The disk of the server is full, so nothing changed.

get.summary: Reads whether password login is on for the install. Only a person signed in to Recall can read it.

401.description: The request has no valid access token.

put.summary:
Turns password login on or off for the install. A turn off is refused until each tenant has an Admin who can sign in with a
provider. Only a person signed in to Recall can change it.

parameters.name: X-Recall-User
parameters.description: The `sub` of `GET /auth/me` when the page opened. A request with the session cookie must send it, and any other value gets a 409 problem with the type `urn:recall:problem:page-user-mismatch`. A request with a bearer token does not send it.

401.description: The request has no valid access token.

507.description: The disk of the server is full, so nothing changed.

post.summary:
Runs discovery against the issuer of the form and saves nothing. A provider that fails is a 200 with the failure, because this
server worked. Only a person signed in to Recall can test one.

parameters.name: X-Recall-User
parameters.description: The `sub` of `GET /auth/me` when the page opened. A request with the session cookie must send it, and any other value gets a 409 problem with the type `urn:recall:problem:page-user-mismatch`. A request with a bearer token does not send it.

401.description: The request has no valid access token.

507.description: The disk of the server is full, so nothing changed.

post.summary: Connects a model provider and makes it the active one. The key goes under the key ring, and no answer holds it.

507.description: The disk of the server is full, so nothing changed.

get.summary: Gets the model providers of the tenant and the state of the key ring. The first one is the active one.

401.description: The request has no valid access token.

put.summary:
Sends the audio of each new Recording to a model provider that takes audio, or keeps it on the server with no provider.
A provider of a kind that takes no audio gets 422.

parameters.name: X-Recall-User
parameters.description: The `sub` of `GET /auth/me` when the page opened. A request with the session cookie must send it, and any other value gets a 409 problem with the type `urn:recall:problem:page-user-mismatch`. A request with a bearer token does not send it.

401.description: The request has no valid access token.

507.description: The disk of the server is full, so nothing changed.

get.summary: Gets the engine that makes the text of the next Recording of the caller, with the reason for a person.

401.description: The request has no valid access token.

delete.summary: Removes a model provider and its key. The provider that was active before it becomes the active one.

parameters.name: X-Recall-User
parameters.description: The `sub` of `GET /auth/me` when the page opened. A request with the session cookie must send it, and any other value gets a 409 problem with the type `urn:recall:problem:page-user-mismatch`. A request with a bearer token does not send it.

401.description: The request has no valid access token.

507.description: The disk of the server is full, so nothing changed.

put.summary: Changes a model provider. A blank key keeps the stored key, but a new base URL needs the key again.

parameters.description: The `sub` of `GET /auth/me` when the page opened. A request with the session cookie must send it, and any other value gets a 409 problem with the type `urn:recall:problem:page-user-mismatch`. A request with a bearer token does not send it.

507.description: The disk of the server is full, so nothing changed.

get.summary: Gets the name of the model provider that gets the words of the next Cleanup of the caller.

401.description: The request has no valid access token.

post.summary: Asks the provider for its list of models. A refusal is a 200 with the words of the provider, because this server worked.

X-Pagination.description: The pagination data for the returned page, as JSON.

401.description: The request has no valid access token.

delete.summary: Deletes a Person of the caller. Each mention of the Person in the Raw and the Cleaned of each Session becomes its label as plain words, and each text that changes makes a Revision. Older Revisions keep their mentions, so a client shows a mention of a Person that the directory does not have as its label. Send `ifVersion`, the version that the caller saw, so that a Person that a rename changed after it stays and the reply is 409. With no `ifVersion`, the delete goes at any version.

parameters.name: X-Recall-User
parameters.description: The `sub` of `GET /auth/me` when the page opened. A request with the session cookie must send it, and any other value gets a 409 problem with the type `urn:recall:problem:page-user-mismatch`. A request with a bearer token does not send it.

401.description: The request has no valid access token.

507.description: The disk of the server is full, so nothing changed.

get.summary: Gets a Person of the caller.

401.description: The request has no valid access token.

put.summary: Renames a Person. Each mention in each Session changes its label, and each text that changes makes a Revision.

parameters.name: X-Recall-User
parameters.description: The `sub` of `GET /auth/me` when the page opened. A request with the session cookie must send it, and any other value gets a 409 problem with the type `urn:recall:problem:page-user-mismatch`. A request with a bearer token does not send it.

401.description: The request has no valid access token.

507.description: The disk of the server is full, so nothing changed.

put.summary:
Sets the full name and the notes of a Person, which tell People of one label apart. The label and each mention stay.
A version that is not the stored version gives 409.

parameters.name: X-Recall-User
parameters.description: The `sub` of `GET /auth/me` when the page opened. A request with the session cookie must send it, and any other value gets a 409 problem with the type `urn:recall:problem:page-user-mismatch`. A request with a bearer token does not send it.

401.description: The request has no valid access token.

507.description: The disk of the server is full, so nothing changed.

post.summary:
Makes a personal access token of the caller with a grant that the caller holds. The answer holds the value of the
token, and no later read gives it again. Only a person signed in to the app can make a token.

parameters.name: X-Recall-User
parameters.description: The `sub` of `GET /auth/me` when the page opened. A request with the session cookie must send it, and any other value gets a 409 problem with the type `urn:recall:problem:page-user-mismatch`. A request with a bearer token does not send it.

401.description: The request has no valid access token.

507.description: The disk of the server is full, so nothing changed.

get.summary:
Gets the personal access tokens of the caller, newest first. A revoked or expired token stays in the list until
the sweep removes it.

401.description: The request has no valid access token.

get.summary: Gets the personal access tokens of a user of the tenant of the caller. Another user needs read_users.

401.description: The request has no valid access token.

post.summary:
Revokes a personal access token. Its next request gets 401. A token that has ended stays as it is, so a second
revoke also gives 204. Its person, or a caller with manage_user_access in the tenant, can revoke it.

parameters.name: X-Recall-User
parameters.description: The `sub` of `GET /auth/me` when the page opened. A request with the session cookie must send it, and any other value gets a 409 problem with the type `urn:recall:problem:page-user-mismatch`. A request with a bearer token does not send it.

401.description: The request has no valid access token.

507.description: The disk of the server is full, so nothing changed.

post.summary:
Starts a Recording in a Session of the caller, or returns the one that has this client recording ID. The first create
gives 201 and a replay gives 200, so a device can send it again after a lost response.

parameters.name: X-Recall-User
parameters.description: The `sub` of `GET /auth/me` when the page opened. A request with the session cookie must send it, and any other value gets a 409 problem with the type `urn:recall:problem:page-user-mismatch`. A request with a bearer token does not send it.

401.description: The request has no valid access token.

507.description: The disk of the server is full, so nothing changed.

get.summary: Lists the Recordings of a Session of the caller. Read one Recording to get its stored slices.

401.description: The request has no valid access token.

delete.summary: Deletes a Recording of the caller and its audio. Text that is saved in the Session stays.

parameters.name: X-Recall-User
parameters.description: The `sub` of `GET /auth/me` when the page opened. A request with the session cookie must send it, and any other value gets a 409 problem with the type `urn:recall:problem:page-user-mismatch`. A request with a bearer token does not send it.

401.description: The request has no valid access token.

507.description: The disk of the server is full, so nothing changed.

get.summary: Gets a Recording of the caller, with its status and, when it has no text, the reason.

401.description: The request has no valid access token.

post.summary:
Ends the upload and queues the work that makes the text. A gap in the slices gives 409, and the slices stay, so a
client can read `storedSlices`, send what is missing, and finish again. A second finish gives the same answer.

parameters.name: X-Recall-User
parameters.description: The `sub` of `GET /auth/me` when the page opened. A request with the session cookie must send it, and any other value gets a 409 problem with the type `urn:recall:problem:page-user-mismatch`. A request with a bearer token does not send it.

401.description: The request has no valid access token.

507.description: The disk of the server is full, so nothing changed.

get.summary: Downloads the audio of a Recording of the caller, as an attachment. A range request is allowed.

401.description: The request has no valid access token.

get.summary: Says if the work behind all audio runs, and what to do when it does not. The capture page shows this.

401.description: The request has no valid access token.

post.summary: Queues a Recording that failed or that still waits for its text. It goes on after the text that is saved, so no text repeats.

parameters.name: X-Recall-User
parameters.description: The `sub` of `GET /auth/me` when the page opened. A request with the session cookie must send it, and any other value gets a 409 problem with the type `urn:recall:problem:page-user-mismatch`. A request with a bearer token does not send it.

401.description: The request has no valid access token.

507.description: The disk of the server is full, so nothing changed.

put.summary:
Stores one slice of the audio. A repeat with the same bytes gives the same answer, and slices can come in any order.
A slice that has other bytes than the stored one gives 409, because a stored slice does not change.

parameters.name: X-Recall-User

401.description: The request has no valid access token.

507.description: The disk of the server is full, so nothing changed.

post.summary:
Adds a Session, or returns the Session that already has this client session ID. The first create gives 201 and a
replay gives 200, so a device can send it again after a lost response. A replay of a deleted Session gives 409.

parameters.name: X-Recall-User
parameters.description: The `sub` of `GET /auth/me` when the page opened. A request with the session cookie must send it, and any other value gets a 409 problem with the type `urn:recall:problem:page-user-mismatch`. A request with a bearer token does not send it.

401.description: The request has no valid access token.

507.description: The disk of the server is full, so nothing changed.

get.summary:
Gets one page of the timeline of the caller, newest first. To get the next page, send the nextCursor of this page
as the cursor. The last page has no nextCursor.

401.description: The request has no valid access token.

post.summary:
Puts the Cleanup result that waits in History into Cleaned. A result waits when Cleaned moved during its run. Send the
number of the waiting Revision and the number of the Cleaned Draft that you read. A newer Cleaned, or a result that no
longer waits, gets 409, so read the Session again. Cleaned before it stays as a Revision.

507.description: The disk of the server is full, so nothing changed.

get.summary: Gets a Session of the caller, with its Raw and its Cleaned. The Session of another person gives 404.

401.description: The request has no valid access token.

get.summary: Gets one Cleaned Revision of a Session, with its text.

401.description: The request has no valid access token.

get.summary:
Gets one page of the Cleaned Revisions of a Session, newest first, with no text. To get the next page, send the
nextCursor of this page as the cursor.

401.description: The request has no valid access token.

get.summary: Gets one Raw Revision of a Session, with its text.

401.description: The request has no valid access token.

get.summary:
Gets one page of the Raw Revisions of a Session, newest first, with no text. To get the next page, send the
nextCursor of this page as the cursor.

401.description: The request has no valid access token.

post.summary:
Stores the Cleanup of a model on the device as a new Cleaned Revision, and Raw does not change. A call while a Cleanup job
runs gets 422. A result applies once. A repeat of it gets 200 with the stored Session and writes nothing, so a later hand
edit, tag, or Cleanup stays.

A base must be the number of a Draft whose words the client holds. The save time decides no save.

name.description: The name of the model provider that gets the words of the next Cleanup. Null when no Cleanup can start yet.

permissions.description: The grant: the most that the agent can hold.

allowedActions.description: The actions that the caller can send for this agent now. A button in the SPA reads this list.

tenantId.description:
Only for a caller that sees all tenants. That caller must name the tenant. A tenant admin always adds to their
own tenant. If a tenant admin sends a tenant, it must be their own tenant.

clientId.description: The client ID in the tokens of the client. Case-sensitive.

mode.description:
"delegated" for a client that acts for a signed-in user, or "machine" for a client that acts for itself with
client credentials. Only a caller that manages all tenants can add a machine agent.

permissions.description: The first grant. The caller must hold each permission. No permission when it is not sent.

recordId.description: The save that wrote the entry. The entries of one save have the same record id.

ordinal.description: The position of the entry in its save.

action.description: The name of the action, for example "users_exported". Null for a data change.

actorSubject.description:
The `sub` of the token of the save. It shows only to a caller with `read_audit_log_sensitive`,
because a provider can make it an email address. Null for system work.

actorClient.description: The client ID of the token of the save. Null for system work.

actorUserId.description:
The ID of the user who acted, also for a delegated agent. Null for system work, for a client that acts for no
user, and for a user with no user record yet.

actorAgentId.description: The ID of the agent that acted. Null when no agent acted.

requestName.description: The MediatR request of the save, for example "UpdateUser.Command". Null for work outside a request.

items.description: The entries of the page, newest first.

nextCursor.description: Send it as the cursor of the next request to get the next page. Null on the last page.

name.description: The property, for example "FirstName", or "Address.City" for one value of a complex property.

old.description: The value before the change. Null for a created value, for an action, and for a hidden value.

new.description: The value after the change, or the value of an action. Null for a hidden value.

hidden.description:
True when the caller has no `read_audit_log_sensitive` and the value is sensitive, or is a value that the
code no longer knows.

stopReason.description: The code of CleanupFailure of a `failed` event.

CleanupEventDto.description: One event of `POST /sessions/{id}/cleanup/stream`. An event holds no words of the journal and no words of a model provider.

baseRawRevision.description: The Revision of Raw that the model read. A later Revision of Raw makes the Session Stale.

baseCleanedRevision.description: The number of the Cleaned Draft that the device read, 0 for the empty Draft. If Cleaned moved after it, Cleaned stays and the result waits in History.

CleanupResultDto.description: A Cleanup that a model on the device did. The server does the same work on it as on the answer of a model provider.

id.description:
The ID that the device made for this Correction, or null for a new ID. It is `cor_` and lower-case letters
or digits, such as `cor_` and a UUID with no hyphens. Another form gives 422. A second create with this ID
returns the same Correction.

name.description: The display name from the token, or null when the identity provider sends no name.

isOwner.description: True when the caller is the Owner of this install, in person. A personal access token is never the Owner.

CurrentUserDto.description: The signed-in caller as the Server sees it in the access token.

timeZone.description: The IANA time zone that the device is in now.

baseRevision.description: The number of the Draft that the person edited. It is `0` for a Draft with no Revision. Only the number of the current Draft wins.

savedAt.description: When the person saved. This time decides no save. With the words, it says that a save is a replay, so a replay sends the same time, and a new save sends a new time.

outcome.description: `Won` and `Unchanged` say that the Draft holds these words. `Kept` answers a replay of a save that won, and says that the Draft took these words at the number in `draftRevision`. The Draft can hold other words now. `Lost` says that the Draft did not take this save, and its words are in a Revision.

draftRevision.description: After `Won`, `Unchanged`, or `Kept`, the number of a Draft that held these words, and the base of the next save. After `Lost`, null: read the Session, merge, and save from the number of the read, with a new `savedAt`.

latestRevision.description: The number of the newest Revision. It is never a base.

EnvironmentLoginProviderDto.description: A provider from `Auth:Providers`. The app cannot change it.

subject.description: The subject that the provider gave the identity. A removal names it with the issuer.

displayLabel.description: The email, else the name, that the provider gave at the link. Null for a link from before Recall kept it.

providerId.description: The ID of the sign-in method with this issuer, or null when no provider on the login page has it, so the link signs no one in.

providerName.description: The name of that provider on the login page, or null.

ExternalLoginDto.description: A link of the user to an identity at a provider. A person signs in with it at that provider.

ExternalLoginForRemovalDto.description: The link to remove, by its issuer and subject (IDP-12).

skippedInJournal.description: The kept entries whose ID became a Session after the put. The Session stays as it is.

skippedDeleted.description: The kept entries whose ID has a Tombstone, because the person deleted its Session after the put.

timeZone.description: The IANA zone of each entry that has no zone of its own.

entryCount.description: The entries that the batch holds now. The accept removes them, so an accepted batch has none.

oneOf.description: The counts of the accept, or null while the batch is open.

version.description: Send it with the accept. Each write to the batch, its entries, or its days moves it.

timeZone.description: The IANA zone of the source, such as `America/Chicago`. Each entry with no zone of its own takes it.

version.description: The version of the batch after the review.

entries.description: At most 500 entries, each Client session ID once.

time.description: The time of the agent as `HH:mm`, or null.

timeZone.description: The zone of the agent, or null for the zone of the batch.

raw.description: The Markdown of the agent, as the put sent it.

isRejected.description: True when the entry or its day is rejected. The accept makes no Session of it.

startsAt.description: The start of the Session that the accept makes now: the time of the person, else of the agent, else 12:00 plus the position in minutes.

wordsChangedAfterEdit.description: True when a put changed Raw after the last edit of the words by the person.

timeChangedAfterEdit.description: True when a put changed the time after the last edit of the time by the person.

version.description: The version of the batch when the entries were read. Send it with the accept.

entries.description: The entries in order of their date and position.

rejectedDays.description: Each day that the person rejected. A rejected day holds each entry of its date.

clientSessionId.description: The ID that the Session of the entry gets at the accept. The same ID again changes the same entry.

date.description: The day of the source, as `YYYY-MM-DD`.

position.description: The order of the entry in its day. With no time, the entry starts at 12:00 plus this number of minutes.

time.description: The time of day as `HH:mm`, only when the source gives one.

timeZone.description: The IANA zone of the entry, or null for the zone of the batch.

raw.description: The words of the source as Markdown, with no change to the words of the person.

words.description: The words of the person as a ProseMirror document, or null to keep the Raw of the agent.

time.description: The time of the person as `HH:mm`, or null to keep the time of the agent.

ImportEntryReviewDto.description: The whole review of one entry. Null clears an edit.

version.description: The version of the batch after the review.

field.description: For `Invalid`, the field of the entry that is not valid.

reason.description: For `Invalid`, why the field is not valid.

positionTakenBy.description: For `PositionTaken`, the Client session ID of the entry that holds the date and the position.

version.description: The version of the batch after the put. A put that stores nothing does not move it.

outcomes.description: The outcome of each entry, in the order of the call.

version.description: The version of the batch after the remove. A remove that deletes nothing does not move it.

outcomes.description: The outcome of each ID, in the order of the call, each ID once.

words.description: The words of the person as a ProseMirror document, or null for the Raw of the agent.

time.description: The time of the person as `HH:mm`, or null for the time of the agent.

state.description: `ReplacedByEnvironment`: an entry of `Auth:Providers` has its ID or its issuer, and that entry wins (IDP-3).

secretState.description: `Unreadable`: the key ring of this server cannot read the secret, so an Admin must enter it again (IDP-5).

LoginProviderDto.description: A login provider of the table. No answer holds the client secret (IDP-4).

id.description: The name of the provider in the sign-in URLs: letters, digits, dashes, or underscores.

LoginProviderForTestDto.description: The fields of the form that discovery needs (IDP-7).

issuer.description: The issuer cannot change (IDP-6). A value other than the stored issuer gets 422, and no value keeps it.

clientSecret.description: A blank value keeps the stored secret (IDP-4).

callbackUrl.description: The callback URL to register at the provider, from the origin of this request, as `/auth/status` gives it (IDP-8).

message.description: The words that the settings page shows for the failure.

issuer.description: The issuer that the discovery document names.

passwordLogin.description: `Off`: the login page has no password form, and a temporary password only links a provider (IDP-15, IDP-20).

LoginSettingsDto.description: The login settings of the install (IDP-13).

passwordLogin.description: A turn to `Off` gets 409 unless each tenant has an Admin who can sign in with a provider (IDP-13).

keyState.description: `Unreadable` means that the key ring of this server cannot read the key, so the Admin must enter it again.

ModelProviderDto.description: A model provider. No answer holds the key.

message.description: The words of the provider, with the key removed.

baseUrl.description: The address that comes before `/models`, for example `http://localhost:11434/v1`. It is required for `OpenAiCompatible`.

apiKey.description: It is required for `Anthropic`. A local `OpenAiCompatible` endpoint can work with no key.
A blank value keeps the stored key. A new base URL needs the key again.

model.description: An ID from the list that the test of this provider gives.

makeActive.description: True makes this one the active provider. False changes nothing.

keyRing.description: `Changed`: a key is not readable, so it was saved under another key ring. `NotWritable`: the key folder takes no write, so the next start makes a new ring.

ModelProviderTestResultDto.description: The answer of the provider to a request for its list of models.

PaginationMetadata.description: The pagination data that a list endpoint sends in the X-Pagination response header.

value.description: The value to send as `Authorization: Bearer`. Copy it now.

PersonalAccessTokenCreatedDto.description: The one answer that holds the value of a token. The Server keeps only its hash, so no later read gives it.

permissions.description: The permissions of the grant. The token holds only those that its person holds too.

jobTools.description: The token may use the job tools at /backwave-mcp while its person is the Owner.

expiresAt.description: Null for a token that never expires.

lastUsedAt.description: Null for a token with no use yet. It can be up to an hour stale.

allowedActions.description: The actions that the caller can send for this token now. A button in the SPA reads this list.

PersonalAccessTokenDto.description: A personal access token as a list shows it. It holds no value and no hash.

permissions.description: The permissions of the grant. The caller must hold each one. No permission when it is not sent.

readJournal.description: The token reads the journal of the person.

writeJournal.description: The token changes the journal of the person. It needs readJournal.

jobTools.description: The token may use the job tools at /backwave-mcp. Only the Owner can send true. False when it is not sent.

expiresAt.description: The end of the token, in the future. Send it or neverExpires, not both.

neverExpires.description: True for a token that works until a revoke. Send it or expiresAt, not both.

PersonDetailsDto.description: The details replace the stored details. A null or blank detail clears it.

matchedPersonIds.description:
Each Person that an approve with no choice reads now: each match of the Cleanup that still exists, then each other Person
of the name. Read the details of each from the People API. With two or more, an approve must name one in
`bindToPersonId` or send `createNew`.

isNew.description: True when IReadOnlyList<string> PersonProposalDto.MatchedPersonIds is empty, so a plain approve adds a Person of the name.

contexts.description: The first sentences of Cleaned that an approval tags, as previews. The number of previews and the width of each have a limit.

approve.description: False drops the proposal. True tags each place in Cleaned.

bindToPersonId.description:
The Person to tag. When this is null and createNew is false, the one Person of this label or of a match of the proposal is
tagged, or a new Person when none is. When two or more are, the approve gets 422 on this field, and the proposal stays.

createNew.description: True adds a Person with this label, also when one has that label. Send it only when a person asks for a second one.

problemText.description: What happened and what to do, for a person. Null when nothing is wrong.

storedSlices.description: The indexes that are stored, so that a client can send the ones that a broken upload lost.

audioFileName.description: The name for the file route. Null while the upload runs and after the audio is gone.

paragraphTapsMs.description:
Each tap of New paragraph, in ms from the start of the audio. Optional, so a client with no button sends none. The
server never refuses them: it sorts them, drops repeats and taps outside 0 to 4 hours, and keeps the first 1,000. The
first finish stores them, and a repeat finish keeps them.

clientRecordingId.description: The ID that the device made for this Recording. A second create with this ID returns the same Recording.

items.description: The Revisions of the page, newest first.

nextCursor.description: Send it as the cursor of the next request to get the next page. Null on the last page.

length.description: The number of characters of the Revision.

journalingDay.description: The date of DateTimeOffset SessionDto.StartedAt in the zone that the create stored. A later change of the settings does not move it.

cleanupBaseCleanedRevision.description: The number of the Cleaned Draft at the start of the last run. While the run runs, a newer Cleaned means its result will wait in History.

waitingCleanupRevision.description: The Cleaned Revision that holds a Cleanup result that did not replace Cleaned, because Cleaned moved during its run. Null when none waits.

cleanupFailure.description: Why the last Cleanup failed. It is a closed code, and the words of a model provider never come here.

metadataVersion.description: Send it with the next metadata save. A save of a Draft does not change it.

clientSessionId.description: The ID that the device made for this Session. A second create with this ID returns the same Session.

startedAt.description: A time in the future becomes the time of the server.

timeZone.description:
The IANA zone that the device used for the day when the person started the Session: the zone that the person picked, or the
zone of the device. Null, or a zone that this host does not know, gives the zone of the settings.

latitude.description: The server does not store a location when capture is off in the settings of the User.

metadataVersion.description: The `metadataVersion` of the Session that the client read. A save from another version gets 409, unless the Session already holds these values.

items.description: The Sessions of the page, newest first.

nextCursor.description: Send it as the cursor of the next request to get the next page. Null on the last page.

cleanupFailure.description: Why the last Cleanup ended with no result. `Stopped` is a stop that the person asked for, not a fault.

metadataVersion.description: Send it with the next metadata save. A save of a Draft does not change it.

SessionSummaryDto.description: One row of the timeline. It has no Draft, so a page costs the same whatever the length of the text.

id.description: Null while the period has no Summary.

periodDate.description: The first Journaling day of the period. A Week starts on a Monday.

periodLastDate.description: The last Journaling day of the period.

status.description: `Missing` and `Stale` come from the sources now. `Failed` is a run that gave no Summary.

failure.description: Why the last run failed. It is a closed code, and the words of a model provider never come here.

content.description: The words of the Summary when the status is `Ready` or `Stale`, and empty otherwise.

sourceCount.description: The sources of the period now: Sessions for a Day or a Week, and source periods with Sessions for a roll-up.

cursor.description: Send it as the cursor of the next pull.

hasMore.description: True when a next page already exists, so pull again with no wait.

sessions.description:
Each changed Session, and each Session that the device already holds and that a Person of this page joins as a match of a
proposal, so that its `matchedPersonIds` are of now.

SyncChangePageDto.description: Each changed row of one page, in its newest state.

SyncTombstoneDto.description: A row that is gone. A device removes its copy, and any local Session with this client session ID.

password.description: The password to give the person. It signs in only to the page where the person picks a password.

TemporaryPasswordDto.description: The one answer that holds a temporary password. The Server keeps only its hash, so no later read gives it.

loginName.description: The name that the person types to sign in. The first issue needs it, and a later issue keeps the name that the first set.

version.description: The version of the tenant that the caller loaded. A stale version gives 409.

modelProviderId.description: The provider that gets the audio. Null sends no audio out, and the local engine makes the text.

model.description: The model that turns audio into text, such as `gpt-transcribe` or `whisper-large-v3-turbo`.

text.description: What it means for the audio, for a person.

TranscriptionEngineDto.description: Where the audio of the tenant becomes text, and why.

jobsStoppedText.description: What it means and what to do, when the jobs stopped. It names no fault.

TranscriptionStatusDto.description: What a person needs to know about the work behind all audio, whatever the Recording.

loginName.description: The name that the user types to sign in with a password. Null until a first temporary password sets it.

allowedActions.description: The actions that the caller can send for this user now. A button in the SPA reads this list.

tenantId.description:
Only for a caller that sees all tenants, such as an allow-listed machine client. That caller must name the tenant.
A user always adds to their own tenant. If a user sends a tenant, it must be their own tenant.

version.description: The version of the user that the caller loaded. A stale version gives 409.

timeZoneMode.description: FollowDevice to take the zone from the device, or Fixed to keep the zone in `timeZone`.

timeZone.description:
For Fixed, the IANA time zone that the person picked. For FollowDevice, the zone of this device now, or null to keep the zone
that holds. The stored zone is always allowed, also when this host does not know it.

removeFillerWords.description: True to have the Cleanup prompt ask the model to remove filler words, stutters, and false starts from Cleaned. Null keeps the stored value, so a client that does not know this field does not change it.

writeNumbersAsDigits.description: True to have the Cleanup prompt ask the model to write a spoken number, date, time, or amount of money in its usual written form in Cleaned, such as "3:30 PM" and "$20". Null keeps the stored value, so a client that does not know this field does not change it.

version.description: The `version` of the settings that the client read. A save from another version gets 409, unless the row already holds these values.

timeZoneMode.description: FollowDevice when the zone comes from the device of the person, or Fixed when the person picked it.

timeZone.description: The zone that gives the Journaling day now: the zone that the person picked, or the zone that a device reported last. Null means UTC.

timeZoneIsKnown.description: False when this host does not know the stored zone. The Journaling day then comes from UTC until the person sets a zone.

removeFillerWords.description: True when the Cleanup prompt asks the model to remove filler words, stutters, and false starts from Cleaned. Raw keeps each word.

writeNumbersAsDigits.description: True when the Cleanup prompt asks the model to write a spoken number, date, time, or amount of money in its usual written form in Cleaned, such as "3:30 PM" and "$20". Raw keeps each word.

revision.description: The Cleaned Revision that holds the waiting result, from `waitingCleanupRevision` of the Session.

baseCleanedRevision.description: The number of the Cleaned Draft that the person read.
